minutes.headline: Board adopted an amended resolution opposing the Kinder Morgan pipeline and Fitchburg lateral through Lunenburg.
minutes.summary: The board reworded and adopted a resolution opposing the Kinder Morgan pipeline, adding paragraphs borrowed from a neighboring town's resolution. The town manager reported on the clean FY2014 audit and a mid-year FY15 review that expects a budget gap, driven mostly by snow and ice. Committee reports, a town accountant raise and announcements rounded out the meeting.

what_happened.line: The Select Board adopted a resolution opposing the Kinder Morgan pipeline and Fitchburg lateral through Lunenburg, after adding paragraphs from another town's resolution.
The board voted to add three paragraphs from the Bolton resolution to the second page before the final adoption.
The town manager's mid-year review of FY15 expects a budget gap, driven mostly by a snow and ice line that is essentially spent.
Reserve fund transfers were sought for police and fire vehicle maintenance and for library utilities; veterans benefits and school choice tuition are also running over.
The town accountant received a salary increase through the contract wage opener, and the next week's meeting was set as the finance committee meeting on the FY16 budget.

why_it_matters: Overruns in snow and ice, veterans benefits, school choice tuition and vehicle upkeep have to be covered from reserve transfers, free cash or stabilization, which are the town budget, mostly taxes.
The pipeline resolution is a statement of position sent to the legislative delegation; it does not by itself decide whether the pipeline is built.
